checkpoint_rule: Final prescribed step only; no checkpoint or pair reselection.

endpoint.aggregation: Give the four trained profiles equal weights. Calculate the endpoint within each seed for the fixed pair of base candidates, then average over the 10 training clusters.
endpoint.name: Normalized finite two-policy dominated hypervolume within each training cluster.
endpoint.outside_rectangle: Retain every point and flag costs above the declared bound. A point above the bound contributes no area. Do not select a new bound or interpolate between policies.

evaluation_seed_namespace: world_seed = 3804000000 + 1000 * training_cluster_index + world_index; policy_seed = world_seed + 50000000. The four profiles share the declared world and policy streams.

intervals.bootstrap: Pointwise 95% paired whole-training-cluster percentile interval with 10,000 resamples. Use NumPy Generator(PCG64). Derive the seed from the first eight bytes, big-endian, of SHA256(recipe_id + slash + contrast_id). Use linear/type-7 quantiles calculated from exact integer-scaled resample sums.
intervals.dz: Paired mean divided by paired sample standard deviation (ddof=1); undefined when that standard deviation is zero.
intervals.paired_t: Pointwise 95% paired-t sensitivity interval with 9 degrees of freedom; explicitly undefined when paired sample variance is zero.

limits: This study compares estimator pathways for fixed J, beta, lambda, and optimizer settings; gradient noise and computational work can affect optimization.
It guarantees no Direct advantage over Fixed, external generalization, or proof efficiency.
The case-summary adapter checks original published replay-audit bindings. It does not perform another raw model/trace replay or attest the publisher.
Exact, score, and conditional estimators use established machinery; no novel unbiasedness theorem is claimed.
readiness_addition: CUDA_READINESS.estimator_modes_pass must equal {exact: true, score: true, conditional: true}. Actual source-bound engineering receipts require external review before launch.
scope: Prospective 10-cluster estimator-mechanism study, separate from the unchanged original global Holm12 family. No scientific outcomes from seeds 64001–64010 were opened during recipe preparation.

test.method: Enumerate all 2^10 paired-cluster sign assignments. Use the absolute mean paired difference, inclusive tail ties, and exact rational/integer arithmetic. Apply no Monte Carlo plus-one correction.
test.null: Joint sign-flip invariance under paired-cluster sign symmetry or exchangeability; this is not a distribution-free test of mean zero alone.
